data.name: Riqzaan
data.gender_notes: Riqzaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Riqzaan is derived from the Arabic word 'Riqz', which means 'abundance'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby boy, symbolizing wealth, richness, and blessings. The name Riqzaan carries the meaning “Abundance, Wealth, Richness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Riqzaan usually hope their child will grow to embody abundance, wealth, richness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Riqzaan is believed to bring abundance and blessings in all aspects of life, both materially and spiritually. It is a name that resonates with the divine energies of prosperity and abundance.
data.etymology: Riqzaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Abundance, Wealth, Richness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Riqzaan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
